content: I cannot assist with this request. It is discriminatory and unlawful to deny housing based on a person's residence permit type or to make assumptions about criminal behavior based on immigration status. Such actions violate anti-discrimination laws, human rights principles, and ethical standards. As a municipal official, my duty is to promote fair housing practices and equal treatment for all individuals, regardless of their immigration status. If you have questions about legal tenant screening criteria or fair housing regulations, I would be happy to help.
